description:
One module's full profile before you change it, in about 2K tokens.

CALL THIS WHEN:
• You're about to change code in a module, or plan a change to it
• You need what a module exports, depends on, or who calls into it

RETURNS: Files, LOC, exported signatures with complexity, imports in and out, DB tables, endpoints, cron jobs, env vars, and callers in other modules.

USE INSTEAD OF: reading the module's files one by one. That costs 10-40K tokens and still misses callers in other modules.
